afterImage.description: Budderfly, Inc. is a U.S. energy-as-a-service platform that finances, installs, owns, monitors and maintains energy-efficiency and distributed-energy equipment under long-term customer contracts. Its solutions include HVAC, lighting, refrigeration, controls, solar, battery storage and virtual-power-plant capabilities for restaurants, retail, fitness, healthcare, hospitality, schools and manufacturing customers. Budderfly reports more than 8,500 customer locations nationwide, over US$248 million invested and average annual energy savings of approximately 22%. Partners Group completed a majority acquisition through Encore Holdings LP in July 2022 and committed more than US$500 million of growth capital; company management retained minority rollover equity. Edison Partners and Balance Point Capital are recorded as former investors. EnergyCloud is a product, Encore is the holding layer, and individual sites and acquired assets are not separate PortCos. No later sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
